claim: After a declared number of consecutive failures the breaker opens and every subsequent call fails fast without invoking the dependency — and it closes only when an explicit probe, allowed no earlier than a declared cooldown, actually succeeds.

steps.note: The retries are what carry one broken service outward into a queue of stuck runs. This is the thousandth error, not the first.

steps.note: Time passing is not evidence of recovery. A breaker that closed on a timer would decide a service is healthy without ever asking it.
